purpose: Define machine-significant runtime/instance configuration fields as explicit schema identities with declared ownership, type and reload/apply semantics.

topics.name: Configuration Field Identity
topics.purpose: Define machine-significant runtime/instance configuration fields as explicit schema identities with declared ownership, type and reload/apply semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Each config field has an explicit stable identity within its owning config schema.
semantics.path_rule: JSON path/key spelling is a serialization binding and not the sole semantic identity.
semantics.secret_rule: Secret values use secret refs rather than inline plaintext.
semantics.reload_rule: Whether a field is hot-reloadable/restart-required/immutable is explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: Config visibility does not grant edit authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: json key alone used as semantic identity

references.purpose: Secret config fields use opaque refs.
